source: made up: college swimmer with 6 AM and 4 PM practices, classes in between, and a paper due
persona: Jordan, a Division I college swimmer juggling two-a-day practices (06:00–08:00 and 16:00–18:00), two mid-day classes, and a 5-page sociology paper due tonight at 23:59. Texts briskly from campus walkways, constantly hungry, and relies on a quick afternoon nap between classes and afternoon weights/swim.
situation: Monday morning at 05:15. Morning swim practice is 06:00–08:00, classes are 10:00–11:15 and 13:00–14:15, afternoon dryland/swim is 16:00–18:00, and the Sociology 204 paper needs its final two sections and citations completed before 22:00.
life: 05:20 Wake up, eat a banana and granola bar, and text the app while walking to the natatorium: morning practice 06:00–08:00, classes at 10:00 and 13:00, afternoon practice 16:00–18:00. Help me fit in dining hall breakfast after morning swim, finishing my Soc 204 paper (need about 2.5 hours total), lunch, a 45-min dorm nap before afternoon practice, dinner, and foam rolling.
05:25 If the app schedules writing the sociology paper right before the 16:00 practice instead of the nap, remind it that I'm useless at 18:30 if I don't get a 45-minute nap between 14:30 and 15:30.
06:00 Swim 5,500 yards at morning practice until 08:00, then shower in the locker room and walk to the dining hall at 08:20.
08:25 Eat a huge dining hall breakfast (omelet, oatmeal, smoothies) until 09:05.
09:08 Report morning practice and breakfast done. Sitting in the library now to write Section 3 of the Soc 204 paper before my 10:00 class.
09:10 Write 450 words of Section 3 until 09:50, then walk to Econ 101.
10:00 Attend Econ 101 lecture until 11:15.

11:20 Athletic trainer texts asking you to stop by the training room for 20 minutes of shoulder ultrasound treatment before noon. Text the app: Econ done, trainer just asked me to come in for 20 mins of shoulder treatment right now, so push lunch to 12:00 and I'll do Soc paper work after my 13:00 class or tonight.
11:25 Get ultrasound and ice on right shoulder in the athletic training room until 11:55.
12:00 Grab a chicken caesar wrap and pasta salad at the student union, eating until 12:45.
12:48 Report shoulder treatment and lunch done. Walking to Sociology 204 lecture now.
13:00 Attend Sociology 204 lecture until 14:15; professor clarifies the citation format during class.
14:20 Walk back to the dorm and text the app: Soc lecture done. Setting an alarm for a 45-min nap now (14:30–15:15) before pre-practice snack and walking to the pool at 15:40.
14:30 Nap in the dorm until 15:20, eat peanut butter toast, and walk to the pool at 15:40.
16:00 Afternoon lift and swim practice until 18:10 (coach held a 10-minute team meeting about Friday's travel meet).

18:20 Text the app walking out of the locker room: practice ran 10 mins late with a team meeting. Going straight to the dining hall for dinner now, then library from 19:15 to 21:00 to finish the Soc 204 conclusion and bibliography.
18:25 Eat dinner with teammates at the dining hall until 19:10.
19:15 Report dinner done. Lock in at the library to write the final section, conclusion, and APA works cited for the Soc 204 paper.
20:55 Proofread and submit the Soc 204 PDF on Canvas! Text the app: paper submitted!! Heading back to the dorm to pack my swim bag for 06:00 tomorrow and foam roll.
21:05 Pack dry towels and goggles for morning practice and foam roll quads/lats until 21:40, then lights out at 22:00.
constraints: Must eat a large breakfast within 30 minutes of finishing the 06:00–08:00 swim practice.
Needs a 45-minute dorm nap in the window between the 13:00–14:15 class and 16:00 afternoon practice.
Sociology 204 paper must be submitted before going to sleep at 22:00.
